statements.sql: INSERT INTO script_vars AS v (name, value_type, int_value) VALUES ('tier', 'int64', 1) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET int_value = excluded.int_value
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, int_value) VALUES ('windowed', 'int64', (SELECT count(*) OVER () FROM script_vars LIMIT 1))
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, int_value) VALUES ('filtered', 'int64', (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE int_value > 0) FROM script_vars))
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, text_value) VALUES ('ordered', 'text', (SELECT name FROM script_vars ORDER BY int_value NULLS LAST LIMIT 1))
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, int_value) VALUES ('distinct', 'int64', (SELECT count(*) FROM script_vars WHERE int_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1))
WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM script_vars) INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, int_value) SELECT 'cte', 'int64', n FROM c
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, text_value) VALUES ('arrow', 'text', (SELECT '{"a":"x"}' ->> '$.a'))
UPDATE script_vars SET int_value = 2 FROM script_inputs WHERE script_vars.name = script_inputs.name
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO script_vars (name, value_type, int_value) VALUES ('joined', 'int64', (SELECT count(*) FROM script_vars a RIGHT JOIN script_inputs b ON a.name = b.name))
DELETE FROM script_vars WHERE name = 'no-such-var' RETURNING name
